In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], a meeting between [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] and her [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] was interrupted when the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]] caught [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tresina Lobi]] [[Spy/Legends|spying]] on the conversation. Rar's subsequent attack on Lobi alerted Lumiya to the presence of both women and, as Solo fled, Lumiya joined the '''lightsaber duel''' that had erupted in the midst of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] '''Fellowship Plaza'''. Lobi held her own against the pair of [[darksider]]s for a time and [[Cho sun/Legends|severed]] Lumiya's weapon [[Limb/Legends|arm]], but was unable to maintain a protracted offensive against two opponents. She was [[Cho mok/Legends|crippled]] by the extensions of [[Lumiya's lightwhip]], then [[Death/Legends|killed]] with a [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitating]] strike of Rar's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Prelude==
===Meeting in the Senate District===
{{Quote|Who are you?''"<br />"''We're a friend. One who doesn't wish Master Skywalker to learn what you are doing with his nephew.|[[Lumiya]] and [[Alema Rar]]|<ref name="Tempest" />}}
Alema Rar, a Dark Jedi and [[joiner]] during the [[Dark Nest Crisis]] and subsequent [[Swarm War]], had been defeated during that conflict's [[Battle of Tenupe|final battle]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], leaving Rar disfigured and mentally unstable. In 40 ABY, Rar reemerged and, seeking revenge on Organa Solo, began targeting her son, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], who had recently turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] under the influence of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Lumiya]].

One day, Solo met with his cousin, [[Ben Skywalker]], in [[Fellowship Plaza]], where they discussed [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] concerns about his son and a new [[Galactic Alliance Guard|GAG]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo.'']]'' '' Observing their conversation were Lumiya, Rar, and [[Tresina Lobi]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] that Luke had sent to monitor Ben. After the meeting's conclusion, Solo sent Ben to the [[Galactic Justice Center]]. As Ben passed Rar, she noticed Lobi eavesdropping on the conversation. Lumiya then left her own hiding place to speak with Solo about his control over Ben, and the possibility of making him his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]. Rar noticed Lobi recording the conversation as Solo told Lumiya to assassinate a list of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] to lure the [[True Victory Party|terrorists]] into a trap. As Lobi prepared to send the recording to Luke, Rar realized that if Solo were to become a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], Organa Solo's heart would be broken, fulfilling her revenge, and so resolved to prevent Lobi from relaying her discovery.

Rar sprang towards Lobi and landed on her shoulder blade, crushing it, then used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to remove Lobi's [[Headset comlink|headset]] and they engaged in a duel. Lumiya, witnessing the fight, told Solo to leave for his meeting with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]]. At first, Lumiya cautiously approached Rar, but the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] stated that she was a friend and the two joined forces to battle Lobi.

==The duel==
{{Quote|You are good, Master Lobi&mdash;but not that good. Even you cannot defeat two of us.|Alema Rar|<ref name="Tempest" />}}
Lobi used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Throw|throw]] an urn into Rar's crippled shoulder before she could redirect it with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], and knocked her into some shrubs behind her. As Rar rose, she saw Lumiya engaging the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with her [[Lumiya's lightwhip|lightwhip]]. As Rar headed towards the fight, Lobi backflipped while pulling Rar into the [[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip's]] strands which cut her thighs and ribs. Lobi landed and [[Cho sun/Legends|sliced off]] Lumiya's [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] weapon [[Limb/Legends|arm]], then aimed for her torso before Rar caught the attack with her own [[Lightsaber/Legends|blade]]. As Lobi attacked the Twi'lek, Rar threw the prosthetic arm towards Lobi's head with the Force. The arm missed, but gave the Lumiya time to attack. Lobi pivoted away and kicked Rar in the chest. As she went flying, Lumiya launched another series of attacks which moved her towards Rar. Lobi whirled around and attacked Rar, but stumbled back into Lumiya's lightwhip and [[Cho mok/Legends|lost both of her legs]]. As Lobi screamed in agony, Rar ended her suffering, and the duel, with a [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitating strike]].

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Do I know you?''"<br />"''Not yet. But we hope you will let us serve you. What you are doing with Jacen is so delicious&mdash;and so right for the Balance.|[[Lumiya]] and [[Alema Rar]]|<ref name="Tempest" />}}
After Lobi had been struck down, Lumiya still remained suspicious of Rar. She stepped to the other side of Lobi's dead body with her lightwhip still activated. It was then that Rar took the recording device from Lobi's corpse, tossed it to Lumiya, and joined her cause.

A [[gardener droid]] found Lobi's body, and notified the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. Luke and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] would investigate Lobi's death, with their investigation leading them and [[Detective/Legends|Detectives]] [[Chal Tozr|Tozr]] and [[Gwad Raatu|Raatu]] to the [[Zorp House]] apartment tower, and [[Apartment three hundred seven twelve|Lumiya's apartment]].

Rar continued to fill a role similar to that of a [[Sith Minion]] in Lumiya's [[Lumiya's Sith|Sith Order]]. She would go on to fight alongside Lumiya at [[Duel on Roqoo Depot|Roqoo Depot]] and [[Battle of Gilatter VIII|Gilatter VIII]], and save Solo's life during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. Ultimately, neither of Tresina Lobi's assassins would survive the Second Galactic Civil War: Lumiya was struck down in a [[Duel on Terephon|duel]] with Luke Skywalker, and [[Jagged Fel]], who had been hunting Rar since the end of the Swarm War, killed her with the help of the other Solos and [[Zekk]]. Solo himself, as the Sith Lord Darth Caedus whose rise and reign Rar had joined Lumiya to help facilitate, perished at the [[Battle of Uroro Station|end of the war]].
